title: STEMI: thrombolysis consent
stem: Resus 2 in a hospital without on-site PCI; the nearest PCI centre is 2½ hours away by road. Mr Siu, 53, has had crushing central chest pain for 2 hours. BP 150/80, HR 78, SpO2 98% in air. Take a focused history, interpret the ECG, and discuss treatment with him.

review.text: Aspirin and oxygen. Your notes (from a 2018 tutorial) give aspirin 160 mg and oxygen if SpO2 is under 94%. ESC 2023 gives aspirin 150–300 mg, and oxygen only if SpO2 is under 90%.

notes:
Checked against the ESC 2023 guidelines for acute coronary syndromes and the Hong Kong Hospital Authority STEMI pathway.

Reperfusion: primary PCI if it can be done within 120 minutes of diagnosis; otherwise fibrinolysis within 10 minutes of diagnosis (tenecteplase weight-based, half dose if 75 years or over), then transfer to a PCI centre: rescue PCI if it fails (less than 50% ST resolution at 60–90 minutes), angiography within 2–24 hours if it works (pharmaco-invasive strategy, outcomes similar to primary PCI in STREAM). Adjuncts: aspirin 150–300 mg, clopidogrel 300 mg (75 mg if 75 or older), enoxaparin or unfractionated heparin. Oxygen only if SpO2 is under 90%. Absolute contraindications include previous ICH or stroke of unknown origin, ischaemic stroke in 6 months, CNS lesion, recent major trauma/surgery/head injury (1 month), GI bleeding in 1 month, known bleeding disorder, aortic dissection, non-compressible punctures in 24 hours.

Your notes (based on a 2018 NTWC tutorial) give aspirin 160 mg and oxygen if SpO2 under 94%; ESC 2023 uses 150–300 mg and under 90%. The rest (history, contraindications, and the argument that delaying for PCI transfer is worse) matches.

steps.label: Focused history
steps.hint: SOCRATES briefly, risk factors, and contraindications to fibrinolysis.

Pain.rz: 心口中間好似俾嘢壓住咁，痛到落左手，兩個鐘前行上斜嗰陣開始。出晒冷汗，想嘔。
Pain.r: Crushing in the middle of my chest, to my left arm, started 2 hours ago walking up a hill. Sweating, feel sick.
Pain.mark: Characterises the pain and onset time

Risks.t: Smoking, diabetes, BP, cholesterol, family history
Risks.tz: 有冇食煙、糖尿病、血壓高、膽固醇高？屋企人有冇心臟病？
Risks.rz: 有食煙，一日三十支。膽固醇高。爸爸五十五歲心臟病發。
Risks.r: Smoker, 30 a day. High cholesterol. Father had a heart attack at 55.

Contraindications.t: Any previous stroke, brain bleed or brain tumour?
Contraindications.tz: 以前有冇中過風、腦出血，或者腦瘤？

Contraindications.t: Any recent bleeding, stomach ulcer, surgery or head injury?
Contraindications.tz: 最近有冇出血、胃潰瘍、做過手術，或者撞傷過個頭？
Contraindications.mark: Screens for bleeding, surgery and trauma

Contraindications.t: Tearing pain through to the back?
Contraindications.tz: 有冇撕裂咁痛，穿到背脊？
有冇食薄血藥、偉哥？有冇藥物敏感？

steps.label: ECG and tests
steps.hint: 12-lead within 10 minutes; bloods; chest film if it doesn't delay.

ECG.r: ST elevation V1–V4 with reciprocal inferior depression: acute anterior STEMI.

Bloods.t: FBC, clotting, U&E, troponin, glucose, lipids

steps.label: Drug cart
steps.hint: Aspirin, clopidogrel, anticoagulant, analgesia; no oxygen unless hypoxic.

opts.t: GTN and IV morphine for pain
High-flow oxygen for everyone with chest pain
opts.r: Oxygen only if SpO2 is below 90% (ESC 2023).

steps.label: Discuss treatment
steps.hint: Explain STEMI, the clot-buster, benefit and risk, why not wait for transfer.

opts.t: You're having a heart attack: an artery to the heart is blocked by a clot. We need to open it quickly to save heart muscle.
opts.tz: 你而家心臟病發：一條供血俾心臟嘅血管俾血塊塞住咗。我哋要快啲打通佢，救返啲心肌。

opts.t: The fastest way here is an injection that dissolves the clot. It works in most people. The main risk is bleeding — serious bleeding in about 1 in 20, and bleeding in the brain in about 1 in 100.
opts.tz: 喺度最快嘅方法係打一支溶血栓針。大部分人都有效。主要風險係出血——大概每二十個有一個嚴重出血，每一百個有一個腦出血。
opts.rz: 我寧願去大醫院通波仔。
opts.r: I'd rather go to the big hospital for the balloon.
opts.mark: Explains fibrinolysis benefits and risks with numbers

turns.line: I'd rather go to the big hospital for the balloon.
turns.lz: 我寧願去大醫院通波仔。

opts.t: The balloon is best only if it can be done within 2 hours; the journey alone is 2½. Every minute counts — 'time is muscle'. We'll give the injection now and then transfer you for an angiogram within 24 hours anyway.
opts.tz: 通波仔要喺兩個鐘內做到先係最好；單係車程已經要兩個半鐘。每一分鐘都好重要——「時間就係心肌」。我哋而家先打針，之後無論點都會喺二十四個鐘內轉你去做血管造影。
opts.mark: Explains the pharmaco-invasive strategy and time dependence

qs.q: When is fibrinolysis preferred to primary PCI (ESC 2023)?
qs.a: When PCI can't be done within 120 minutes

wrong: Complete relief of the chest pain within 60 minutes
A reperfusion arrhythmia such as AIVR
Diabetic retinopathy on the last eye screen

qs.q: Tenecteplase dose adjustment at 75 or older?

badge.name: Time Is Muscle
badge.flavor: No PCI in 120 minutes? Lyse now, transfer after.

cards.q: Fibrinolysis should start within how long of STEMI diagnosis?

options: Fibrinolysis with no angiography unless symptoms recur
For all patients with chest pain, at 15 L/min

cards.q: Clopidogrel loading with fibrinolysis in a 60-year-old?

cards.why: Less than 50% ST resolution or ongoing ischaemia.
